description: References for story-age numbers remembered from earlier MoonWitness concepts. Not personal identity records and not religious rulings.
epistemicRules: Treat human age, fictional visual age, service tenure, narrative duration, scriptural account and cosmic age as distinct dimensions.
40 years in Quran 46:15 is a reflection reference, not a magical promotion threshold.
Under-40 story label is not a believer gate; all adults may participate within lawful role constraints.
100 years in Nevermore is an aspiration not an unconditional lifespan guarantee.
950 Quranic years denotes time among Noah's people, not confirmed total lifespan.
Unknown angel ages are null; 25–45 is only the fictional visual design of a WINGS representative.
Age-related forgiveness and punishment are never automated or divinely ranked.
Year unit and calendar method must be explicit; 63 lunar years is not 63 solar years.
40 days and 40 nights is a campaign period and not a character's chronological age.
Keep project testimony separated from scripture, historicity, prediction and empirical measurement.

records.title: AWS / Angel With a Shotgun — Age Modifier
records.description: A remembered age-19 case proposes context-sensitive assessment of maturity, capacity, dependence and responsibility. It does not justify automatic mercy, punishment, or theological judgment.

records.title: WE ARE SAVAGES — Under 40
records.description: Project narrative category for people under 40, associated in prior storytelling with commitments and ethical actions; NEVER use as a minimum faith requirement or a disqualifier for older persons.

records.title: Age 40 — maturity and gratitude
records.description: Quran 46:15 mentions forty years in a reflection on maturity, gratitude, parents and descendants. It is not a universal automatic promotion or moral score.

records.title: Road to 40 — Forty Days and Forty Nights
records.description: A forty-day/forty-night program duration, not a person's 40th birthday or proof of supernatural occurrences. Event observations, including astronomical/night/subuh observations, remain separately logged with timestamps and corroboration.

records.title: 63 lunar years — age-reconstruction hypothesis
records.description: A remembered reconstruction used lunar counting; calendar model, exact endpoints, conversion and uncertainty are mandatory. Another historical MoonWitness calculation suggested roughly 64.1 lunar years under different dates; do not silently combine competing chronologies.

records.title: NEVERMORE / ANTIDOTE — Story of the Years
records.description: A prior project story expressed a hope or prayer for a century or more of opportunities for repentance, worship and good deeds. It is not a biomedical guarantee, fate, eligibility test or automated promise.

records.title: Isaiah 65:20 — 100 years
records.description: In a prophetic restoration context the passage depicts a hundred years as young. Not a universal human biological threshold, a modern mortality prediction or proof anyone who dies younger is cursed.

records.title: Hezekiah — fifteen added years
records.description: A particular account of fifteen additional years for Hezekiah; not a general procedure to extend a person's lifetime.

records.title: Noah — 950 years among his people
records.description: Quran 29:14 says Noah stayed among his people a thousand less fifty years. This is NOT a direct statement of his complete biological lifespan.

records.title: Methuselah — 969 years
records.description: Genesis 5:27 attributes 969 years to Methuselah. Store as a textual claim in its tradition; do not treat as a validated target or general biological benchmark.

records.title: Jesus/Isa — about thirty at ministry start
records.description: Luke 3:23 says Jesus was about thirty as he began his ministry. Other estimates such as approximately 33 are inferences, not exact dates stated in the Quran.

records.title: Actual angels — no numeric age in Quran
records.description: No reliable numerical age is provided in the cited Quran verses; WINGS 10 is a human organizational design and has no angel biological birthday.

records.title: Swap Karunia — renouncing personal longevity
records.description: A prior MoonWitness story expresses preferring others' welfare over receiving longevity/immortality personally; model only as attributed testimony or narrative intent, never as proof of a supernatural transfer.

records.title: Future Is Now — return-to-life hope
records.description: A theme about a second chance after death. Quran 23:99–100 describes the request to return and a barrier until resurrection; no software age engine can resurrect a person or mark such an event as verified.

records.title: Aetherion — 33 open / 100 planned levels
records.description: 33 and 100 are journey or game-like progression markers, not biological age, guaranteed heaven admission or spiritual rank.

records.title: Cosmic chronology vs lunar cycles
records.description: Cosmic age depends on observational cosmology and a declared model. Antikythera-style cycles and lunar phase age cannot be used to calculate human or universal age directly.

records.title: WINGS 10 visual range 25–45
records.description: The appearance range 25–45 is a purely art-direction default for human representation; there is no scripture-based age of the ten named angel motifs.

records.title: G.O.D. 99 visual range 18–39
records.description: The 18–39 design range can visually echo the project's under-40 youth aesthetic, but confers no faith ranking, biological age requirement, role promotion or spiritual identity.
